news_cards.title: Andhra Pradesh, Australia sign four MoUs for education, clean energy and skill development
bullets: Andhra Pradesh sarkar aur Australia ne milkar chaar MoUs par sign kiya hai, jismein education, clean energy aur skill development shamil hai
In MoUs ke tahat, Andhra Pradesh ko 4500 crore rupees ka nuksan hoga, aur yeh MoUs state ke liye bahut faydemand honge
Yeh MoUs Andhra Pradesh ke Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu ke dwara launch kiye gaye hain, aur ismein Australia ki sarkar bhi shaamil hai

news_cards.title: Centre announces relief package for tobacco farmers
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne tobacco farmers ke liye relief package ka elaan kiya hai, jismein unhein 50,000 rupees ka interest-free loan diya jayega
Is package ke tahat, lagbhag 45,000 tobacco farmers ko laabh hoga, aur sarkar ne iske liye 200 crore rupees ka budget allocate kiya hai
Yeh package tobacco farmers ke liye bahut faydemand hoga, kyunki ve apne utpaadan ke liye acchi keemat pa sakenge

news_cards.title: Andhra Pradesh, Australia sign MoU for innovation and advanced manufacturing
bullets: Andhra Pradesh sarkar aur Australia ne milkar ek MoU par sign kiya hai, jismein innovation aur advanced manufacturing shamil hai
Is MoU ke tahat, Andhra Pradesh mein ek innovation hub banaya jayega, jahaan par startup aur MSMEs ko sahayata di jayegi
Yeh MoU Andhra Pradesh ke liye bahut faydemand hoga, kyunki yeh state ko innovation aur advanced manufacturing ke kshetra mein aage badhne mein madad karega
